description: Regular periodic reviews of user access rights are not being conducted. This signal indicates the absence of a process to regularly validate that user access permissions remain appropriate and aligned with current job responsibilities as required by HITRUST CSF.
applicability: Healthcare organizations subject to HIPAA, Organizations pursuing HITRUST certification, Systems processing sensitive health information

metadata.detection_notes: Detection involves checking for documented access review schedules, examining review records, and verifying that periodic access certifications are performed.

name: Periodic Access Review Missing
